messages:
jordan.devex: Heads-up — discovered an SDK vs REST parity bug that shows up in the sampleapp onboarding flow. Intermittent 401s during token refresh when the optional header `X-Session-Trace` is included as the string 'false'.

maya.sdk: huh, odd. REST calls with the same header work in our local curl tests? :thinking:

jordan.devex: Yep. Repro steps included below. curl -> success, SDK -> 401 occasionally. The key difference appears to be the header serialization and the SDK retry logic.

satish.eng: can you paste the repro?

jordan.devex: Repro (minimal):

```
# curl (works)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Session-Trace: false" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/onboard
```

SDK (node) snippet that sometimes fails:

```
await client.onboard({ body }, { headers: { 'X-Session-Trace': false } });
```
When the SDK sends the header it stringifies to `'false'` sometimes, and other times it omits it. The server treats the explicit string 'false' as a trigger to consult session cache and may return a 401 during refresh window. Our REST path normalizes header presence differently which is why curl is consistent.

maya.sdk: the SDK should normalize boolean header values to the absence of the header when false. Currently our request serializer does `String(headerValue)` which yields 'false'. That explains the different server branch.

laura.platform: also FYI the SDK has auto-retry semantics: it treats 401 during a refresh call as retriable and will re-send the original request after a refresh. That causes the sampleapp to create duplicate onboarding records in some customers' flows.

satish.eng: ouch. So two differences: header normalization and retry policy. Both combine to produce visible customer impact.

jordan.devex: Exactly. Proposed immediate fixes: 1) SDK: treat boolean header false as omit; 2) SDK: mark token-refresh 401s as non-retriable for POST-onboard path (or make retry idempotency-aware); 3) add an integration test that exercises X-Session-Trace variations.

maya.sdk: Agree. I'll open a PR with the serializer change and a unit test. For retries, we should add a conservative default: only retry 401s for GET/HEAD idempotent requests. That will be a small behavior change but safer.

laura.platform: We should also add a short note in the onboarding quickstart: "do not send X-Session-Trace when false; prefer omitting header" — until serverside accepts explicit false.

satish.eng: Can someone create a quick CI test that stubs server behavior for the refresh window and asserts no duplicates? I can help wire it into the sampleapp pipeline.

maya.sdk: I'll add serializer + retry policy change PR and include the new test harness. Will tag @satish.eng for the sampleapp integration test.

jordan.devex: Thanks. Action items: 
- maya.sdk: PR for header normalization + retry heuristic (ETA EOD PST)
- satish.eng: add sampleapp integration test to detect duplicate creates (ETA tomorrow)
- laura.platform: short quickstart doc blurb (ETA today)

ci-bot: deploy-checklist: lint ok, unit-tests pending for sdk.

maya.sdk: noted, pushing a branch now. Will link the PR here when ready.

jordan.devex: thx — marking this high-priority for the next SDK patch release.

laura.platform: Also let's schedule a brief postmortem if we see customer impact.

maya.sdk: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/452 (draft)

jordan.devex: saw the draft, left comments on tests. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
